Changes:
0: [sign_in, redesign] Grid layout sign-in screen redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen into a grid layout with visual cards for social and email authentication options. (why: Sign-in step has a 76.9% completion rate and 8 support tickets concerned missing or reset pets after signing back in; clear authentication choices reduce login mistakes.)
1: [finish, redesign] Two-column finish screen layout: Redesign home_intro into a two-column layout highlighting desktop pet arrival on the left and immediate launch controls on the right. (why: Finish step drop-off is 74.5% with mean time over 5800 seconds; side-by-side layout clarifies initial setup actions immediately.)
2: [choose_path, copy] Story screen pet companion promise copy: Update story screen headline and body to emphasize account data protection and permanent pet saving. (why: 8 users reported lost or reset pets after re-signing in; establishing data persistence promises early reduces user anxiety.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting screen background preparation tip: Display background rendering tips and step status messages while waiting for the pet to launch on desktop. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s (mean 2336s), leading users to worry that the app has stalled or crashed.)
4: [adoption, layout] Compact layout for adoption certificate: Switch adoption_certificate layout to compact view with prominent pet naming input and quick confirm action. (why: Adoption stage takes median 89s / mean 1017s; compact layout reduces scrolling and decision friction before finalizing.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop taskbar tray interaction hint: Add a direct hint on the home intro screen explaining how to summon or hide the pet using the system tray. (why: 3 support emails expressed confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet once onboarding finishes.)
6: [choose_path, layout] List layout choose path redesign: Reformat choose_path screen to a list layout with concise path option descriptions. (why: Path selection conversion is 76.2% with high mean time (514s); structured list formatting makes path choices easier to scan.)
7: [sign_in, copy] Sign in account restoration emphasis copy: Update sign-in headline to explicitly mention account restoration for returning pet owners. (why: 8 support emails reported lost pets when signing back in; clear copy reassures returning users that signing in restores existing pets.)
